name: Get the Goblins Drunk
label: Quest
description: Kravel Koalbeard wants the Fool's Stout tested on a pit crew at the Mirage Raceway. If you choose the goblins, you take the stout to the Goblin Pit Boss.…
intro: Kravel Koalbeard wants the Fool's Stout tested on a pit crew at the Mirage Raceway. If you choose the goblins, you take the stout to the Goblin Pit Boss. The stout will go bad eventually, so Kravel says not to wait too long.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: We need to try the Fool's Stout on one of the pit crews. If you want to try it on the goblins, then here -- take the stout and give it to the goblin pit boss.
And don't wait too long. This stout will go bad eventually.

clips.title: Completion
paras: What do we have here? Booze, eh?
Well, I don't mind if we have just a little...

related.n: Zanzil's Mixture and a Fool's Stout
